text: The darker the night, the brighter the stars.

archive.text: Life is available only in the present moment.

archive.text: Keep silence for the most part, and speak only when you must, and then briefly.

archive.text: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
archive.author: Gautama Buddha

archive.text: By nature, men are nearly alike; by practice, they get to be wide apart.

archive.text: It is health that is real wealth and not pieces of gold and silver.
archive.author: Mahatma Gandhi

archive.text: To love or have loved, that is enough.
archive.author: Victor Hugo

archive.author: William Londen
